name: execute_smart_home_action
description: Controls any device across Home Assistant or custom plugins (lights, locks, climate, AVR, vacuum, garage).

domain.description: e.g., light, media_player, vacuum, cover, switch, webhook

action.description: e.g., turn_on, turn_off, volume_set, volume_mute, select_source, start, trigger

target_id.description: Entity ID or custom device identifier

payload.description: Optional parameters like brightness, temperature, or JSON body

name: control_camera_view
description: Opens, maximizes, or closes a live UniFi Protect camera stream in the UI overlay.

camera_id.description: Name or ID of the camera (e.g., driveway, patio, front_door)

name: manage_timer
description: Sets, cancels or lists timers and reminders. They ring with a chime and a spoken alert in the app, even after this conversation ends.

kind.description: timer = countdown ("10 minute pasta timer"); reminder = message at a time ("remind me at 5 to call mom")

label.description: Short name or reminder text, e.g. pasta, call mom. For cancel: the label to match, or all.

at.description: For set: local 24-hour time HH:MM (next occurrence), or an ISO 8601 local date-time.

name: ask_google_home
description: Sends a typed command to Google Home (Google Assistant) for devices that are linked to Google Home but missing from the device list, e.g. a Level lock. Returns Google's reply text if it gives one.

command.description: Plain command as you would say it to Google, e.g. "lock the front door", "is the front door locked".
